description:
Change the metadata of a picture, video, sound file or PDF. Fields are named `group/key`, as
`inspect` lists them (`exif/Model`, `gps/GPSLatitude`, `file/Title`); `group/key#2` is the
second field of that name. Takes image, video, audio, pdf files.

output_dir.description: Absolute folder for the results; default: the user's setting.

remove_all.description: Remove everything that can be removed (a photo keeps its orientation).

remove_camera.description: Remove the camera and its settings, the GPS position and the dates.

set.description: Fields to set, `{"file/Title": "Holiday"}`; only text fields can be set.

name: metadata
title: Change the metadata
